basics.name: João Pedro Moreira Campos de Lima
basics.label: Backend Developer | Java/Spring Boot & Python/FastAPI | APIs, Microservices and Docker
basics.summary: Backend developer specialized in building APIs, microservices, and data-oriented systems with Java/Spring Boot, JSF/PrimeFaces, Python/FastAPI, Docker, Apache Kafka, and relational/non-relational databases. Experienced in ETL pipelines, AI automations, service integrations, and critical administrative systems with authentication, authorization, and access control.

work.name: Department of Information and Communication Technology (DETIC) - UECE
work.summary: Software development project using Java 8 on the backend and JSF with PrimeFaces on the frontend, focused on improving the monolithic academic platform for the graduate studies system at the State University of Ceará.
highlights: Worked on development and maintenance of the academic system, contributing feature implementations and bug fixes.
Supported requirements gathering and feature validation with the team.
Handled data using PostgreSQL and Metabase.

work.name: Computer Vision and Engineering Center (NUVEN) - IFCE
work.position: Backend, DevOps and Data Developer Intern
work.summary: Analytical platform for collecting, processing, and interpreting social media data, focused on intelligence, automation, and decision support.
highlights: Designed ETL pipelines to collect, normalize, and enrich data from Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, consolidating multiple sources into a unified analytical base.
Structured an event-driven integration with Apache Kafka, decoupling ingestion, processing, and consumption to make the data flow more modular and easier to evolve.
Delivered dashboards, analytical queries, and KPIs over thousands of records per cycle, turning raw data into operational visibility for decision-making.
Applied automatic classification and virality prediction models to structured and unstructured data, reducing dependency on manual analysis.
Organized data flows with a focus on traceability, recurring analyses, and continuous evolution of the analytical base.

work.name: Movias Solutions - UECE
work.summary: Data-oriented backend solution with microservices for ingestion, processing, classification, and prediction.
highlights: Modeled a Python/FastAPI microservices architecture, separating ingestion, processing, and prediction responsibilities by domain.
Developed an AI pipeline with Scikit-Learn, classification, and clustering (K-Means), automating segmentations that previously depended on manual analysis.
Centralized service access through a gateway with OpenAPI documentation and health checks, improving integration, diagnostics, and observability.
Standardized the environment with Docker, reducing inconsistencies between development and service execution.
Structured reusable components to simplify maintenance, service evolution, and integration between pipeline stages.

work.name: LabVicia - IFCE
work.summary: Development and evolution of Integra-MEC, SETEC/MEC's administrative system, focused on backend, security, and critical internal workflows.
highlights: Developed full stack modules with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and TypeScript, connecting backend, frontend, and business rules in end-to-end features.
Implemented authentication, authorization, and access control with Keycloak, strengthening security and governance for multiple user profiles.
Developed REST APIs with filters, pagination, and report generation, reducing operational rework and increasing user autonomy.
Worked on corrective maintenance and feature evolution by analyzing existing rules, adjusting flows, and delivering improvements with lower regression risk.
Collaborated on translating administrative requirements into technical solutions aligned with the product's operation.

work.name: Núcleo de Desenvolvimento de Software (NDS) - IFCE
work.summary: Backend development with C#/.NET, REST APIs, and microservices for the evolution of internal systems.
highlights: Developed and maintained REST APIs in C#/.NET in a microservices architecture, delivering new endpoints and continuous improvements to backend services.
Applied CQRS to separate responsibilities, simplify domain evolution, and reduce coupling between business rules.
Implemented MySQL integrations, optimized queries, and unit tests with mocks to increase reliability and reduce regressions.
Participated in corrective and evolutionary maintenance of services, connecting product demands, business rules, and backend implementation.
Worked on code reviews and Scrum/Kanban ceremonies, contributing to technical consistency, code quality, and knowledge sharing within the team.

education.institution: Federal Institute of Education, Science and Technology of Ceará (IFCE)

volunteer.position: Full Stack Developer - Open Source Contribution
volunteer.summary: Open source contribution to the evolution of UBL, an academic platform for browsing curricula, courses, and student progress.
highlights: Contributed to UBL's academic portal with Next.js, React, TypeScript, tRPC, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, improving curriculum navigation and course lookup for 2 undergraduate programs.
Implemented authentication, route protection, validations, and rate limiting, strengthening security and reliability for public and authenticated usage.
Developed progress-tracking flows and learning-path organization, reducing usage friction and improving content discovery.
Standardized the environment and delivery with Docker, Prisma, and GitHub Actions, automating build and deployment through CI/CD.
